findings.title: workingHours check compares start==end, always false condition
findings.body: In checkIfIsAvailable, `const end = slotStartTime.hour() * 60 + slotStartTime.minute();` duplicates the computation of `start` instead of using slotEndTime. This makes the working-hours boundary check (`end > workingHour.endTime`) effectively check the slot start time twice instead of validating the slot's end time against working hours, so slots that end after working hours but start within them will incorrectly be considered available.

findings.title: Dayjs object comparison with === never true
findings.body: `if (dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, "minutes") === dayjs(date.end).add(utcOffset, "minutes"))` compares two different Dayjs object instances with strict equality, which is always false since Dayjs objects are not primitives. This dead code branch (meant to detect override start===end, i.e. an all-day-unavailable override) never triggers, so overrides representing a fully blocked day won't be handled as intended.

findings.title: Override's own date may shift when offset computed relative to invitee tz with DST mismatch
findings.body: The override startTime/endTime are computed as `dayjs(override.start).utc().add(offset,'minute')` where offset = inviteeUtcOffset - organizerUtcOffset. However `organizerUtcOffset` is derived from `override.start` parsed with `dayjs(override.start.toString())` rather than from the already-known override.timeZone-based organizer time directly; if `override.start` lacks timezone info (just a date string), `dayjs(override.start.toString()).tz(override.timeZone)` may misinterpret the local wall time, causing an incorrect offset and shifted slot times for overrides near DST transitions.

findings.title: No test coverage for round-robin + date override interaction
findings.body: The PR's primary claimed fix is that fixed-host date overrides are respected in round-robin events, but no test in this file exercises a round-robin event type combined with a date override for a fixed host. Only the plain date-override timezone case and existing round-robin busy-time tests are covered, leaving the main bug fix for issue #8207 unverified by tests.
